ground_truth.method: visual montage sampling (every 20 frames over the full window + every 1-2 frames across each suspected drop region), strong gamma+CLAHE brightening for the dark IR footage
ground_truth.notes: Single aerial (rope) dancer, present in every frame of [1500,1800) - inverted/spread/swinging poses, small and fast. N=1 constant. The current tuned config under-reports the dancer (reported=0) at abs frames 1515-1524, 1643-1654, 1764-1786 - all visually confirmed dancer-present => genuine DROPS (the residual field pain). Abs 1500-1514 is structural track-confirmation warmup (excluded by warmup=15); detection is also intermittent there so 1515-1524 still scores as drops. No over-counts (reported never exceeded 1).
